text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! ☆ Thank you so much for the
wishes!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It appears birthdays are particularly
special for
you, given your voice is
somehow at an even
higher pitch.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you notice things like that about
me? How
stupendously studious you are!
Marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's the "marvelous" you say to
Nature, the one
you give to praise
someone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And that's the "marvelous" you say when
you're
struck by sudden surprise.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now this is a first! What kind of meaning
would
you say lies within that
"marvelous"?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It sprang up because we've grown closer

together—a brand-new marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Birthdays bring about all sorts of new
marvelous
things. What a marvelous day!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems I still need more time to
understand...
but I'm very happy to know
we've become closer.
